history.name: An identity that survives a rename
history.description: A feature is identified by a short stable handle that never changes, separate from the name it goes by. Renaming what a feature is called leaves its history intact underneath, so the record follows one capability through every name it has had.
history.dev_notes: Lower-case kebab-case, enforced in Feature#validate; the display name lives in the history entries, so #currentName is whatever the latest naming entry said.
